lines.2: Pehle dono lengths ko centimetre mein bataiye: 3 metre, 300 centimetre hota hai. Ab 300 centimetre aur 250 centimetre mein kaunsa bada hai?
lines.3: Bilkul, aapne same unit mein compare karke sahi dekha: 300 centimetre, 250 centimetre se bada hai. Ab 2 kilometre 75 metre ko metres mein badliye.
lines.4: 2 kilometre ko 2,000 metre, phir 75 metre jodkar aapne 2,075 metre likha. Khaali jagah bhariye: 2,700 is more than 2,075, so 2,700 m is farther, by ___ m.
lines.5: Arjun, aapki baat saaf nahi sun paayi—kripya ise ek baar phir se kahiye. Khaali jagah bhariye: 2,700 is more than 2,075, so 2,700 m is farther, by ___ m.
lines.6: Khaali jagah bhariye: 2,700 is more than 2,075, so 2,700 m is farther, by ___ m.
lines.7: Bilkul, 625 metre sahi hai: aapne 2,700 mein se 2,075 ghataaya. Ab agle distance comparison par dhyaan dijiye. Kaun lamba hai: 2 km ya 500 m?
lines.8: Aapne sahi doubt pakda: units alag hain, isliye pehle dono distances ko ek hi unit mein badalna hoga. Kaun lamba hai: 2 km ya 500 m?
lines.9: Aapne 1 kilometre ko 1,000 metre mein badal kar, phir dono ko compare kiya—yeh sahi conversion step hai. Kaun lamba hai: 2 km ya 500 m?
lines.10: Haan Arjun, 2 kilometre lamba hai. Aapne kaise jaana ki 2,000 metre, 500 metre se bada hai?

lines.12: Bilkul, 500 ka do samooh 1,000 hota hai. 2,000 mein 500 ke kitne samooh honge?
lines.13: Haan, chaar groups bilkul sahi. Game baad mein; pehle is distance puzzle ka agla step dekhte hain. Stadium se chaar metro exits 2 km 90 m, 2,009 m, 2 km 900 m a
lines.14: Aapki pehli conversion mein step टूटा: 2 km 90 m equals 2,090 m, 2,900 m nahi. Ab 2,009, 2,090, 2,190, 2,900 ko kram mein rakhiye.

lines.0: Namaste Saanvi, main Asha, aapki AI teacher. Aaj Relations among sequences dekhenge. Aapko cycling ya music mein kya zyada pasand hai?
lines.1: Saanvi, aapko cycling aur music sunna pasand hai—achha combination! Rangoli mein 1, 3, 5 dots wali lines banengi; aapko total dots mein kya pattern dikhega?
lines.2: Bilkul, aapne totals 1, 4, 9 pehchaane. Consecutive odd numbers ka sum square number banta hai. Ab 1, 3, 5, 7 ka total bataiye.
lines.3: Saanvi, picture mein pehle corner par 1 dot rakha hai; ab square banane ke liye kitne naye dots jodenge?
lines.4: L-shape se square ka next step dikh raha hai. Ab isi pattern ko dhyaan se apply kijiye. Khaali jagah bhariye: Add 3 dots as an L around it: a 2 by 2 square, ___
lines.5: Bilkul, 2 by 2 square mein 4 total dots aur 3 naye dots hote hain. Ek square rangoli mein 5 rows hain, har row mein 5 dots. Meera neeche aur daayein kinaare par
lines.6: Corner ko ek hi baar giniye, phir aage badhiye.
lines.7: Aapne dono nayi lines ke 5-5 dots gine, par corner dono mein aa gaya. Ab use ek baar hataakar calculation bataiye. Meera neeche aur daayein kinaare par dots jod
lines.8: Think of the border as the next odd-sized layer. Meera neeche aur daayein kinaare par dots jodkar use 6 rows aur 6 columns ka banati hai. Kitne dots judte hain?
lines.9: Aapne 9 kaha tha; meri galti, maine wahi baat phir se pooch di. Upar aur neeche: 1 + 2 + 3 + 4 + 5 + 4 + 3 + 2 + 1 kitna hai? Yeh kis tarah ka number hai?
lines.10: Aap pattern dekh rahe hain: beech ka 5, dono taraf ghatte numbers. Ab in jodon ko milaiye: 1+1, 2+2, 3+3, 4+4, phir beech ka 5.
lines.11: Aapne pairs jodkar total nikala. Upar aur neeche: 1 + 2 + 3 + 4 + 5 + 4 + 3 + 2 + 1 kitna hai? Yeh kis tarah ka number hai?
lines.12: Haan, aapka 25 bilkul sahi hai: 5 times 5, isliye yeh square number hai. Stadium mein square grid ki lights stages mein jalti hain: pehle 1, phir 3 aur, phir 5
lines.13: Pattern mein odd numbers kram se aate hain: 1, 3, 5, 7… 19. Aap inhe jodkar total ko 10 times 10 se milaiye.
lines.14: Aap 10 terms gin chuke hain; ab square number ka pattern bolkar poora kijiye.
